worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.summary: Stands still and swings its tough tail across the ground in a wide fan: every enemy caught takes contact damage, is shoved away and has its Attack lowered by one stage; the swept ground keeps a short-lived furrow. Wide mode covers more, focused mode hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.use.0: Lower a whole crowd pressing in at once
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.use.1: Shove everyone adjacent away and open space
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.use.2: Use the furrow and shove to steer opponents on tight ground
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.descript: Every enemy in the fan takes %1$s contact damage.
Sweeps a %1$s block, %2$s degree fan from itself toward the target.
Push targets outward %1$s blocks and lower Attack by %2$s stages.
The swept ground keeps a furrow for about %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.wide.on: Wide: the fan opens to 235 degrees and the radius x1.12 to cover a whole crowd, at the cost of x0.85 power, +2 wind-up and +8 cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.wide.off: Focused: power x1.12 hits harder, but only sweeps the strip in front.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it recovers for %3$s, spends %4$s PP, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep rises again to %2$s power and the radius grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.breakingswipe.preferen: On: the fan opens to 235 degrees and the radius x1.12 to cover a whole crowd, at the cost of x0.85 power, +2 wind-up and +8 cooldown ticks. Off (focused): power x1.12 hits harder, but only sweeps the strip in front.
The companion only swings once the target is within this distance; larger values swing earlier and miss more while still out of position.
On: a target with other enemies within 3.2 blocks ranks higher, so one sweep lowers several at once. Off: ordinary combat ordering.
